hooks.command: root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-${GROK_WORKSPACE_ROOT:-}}"; [ -z "$root" ] && root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; command -v ccc >/dev/null && ! printf '%s' "${COCOINDEX_CODE_INDEXING_ROLE:-}" | grep -qi '^[[:space:]]*member[[:space:]]*$' && test -f "$root/.cocoindex_code/settings.yml" && [ "$(cd "$root/.cocoindex_code" && pwd -P)" != "$(cd "${COCOINDEX_CODE_DIR:-$HOME/.cocoindex_code}" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)" ] && (cd "$root" && ccc index) 2>/dev/null || true
